displayName: Azure AI governance tags should use approved values
description: Audit or deny core Azure AI resources when a selected tag is missing, empty, or outside an approved value list. This validates the label, not the underlying risk or behavior. Audit is the default; Deny requires explicit selection.

metadata.description: Audit reports noncompliance by default. Deny blocks noncompliant create or update requests when explicitly selected.
Target parent resource types that support tags. Extend deliberately for supporting services.
Assign separately for ai-role, ai-usage, ai-audience, ai-sharing, ai-autonomy, and ai-risk, using the corresponding values from the tag baseline.
Supply at least one approved, nonempty value. Tag presence and nonempty content are required independently of this list.
